runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: Price **$38.43** (close 2026-10-16, `tools/run.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares 214,494,967 common on the cover of the 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (0000884614-26-000052, as of 2026-07-31), `Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing, against 217,706,132 issued less about 3.2 million treasury shares on that 10-Q's balance sheet; the 8-Ks after the 10-Q issue no shares; the $700M convertible notes due 2028 settle in cash up to principal. Sovereign **5.43%**, the US Treasury 30-year par yield of 2026-10-16 (`tools/run.py`, issuing authority). Read from the 10-K for FY2025 (year to September 30; 0000884614-25-000053), the 10-Ks for FY2019, FY2021, FY2022 and FY2023, the 10-Q to 2026-06-30, the proxy of 2025-12-17 (0001104659-25-122095) and the 8-Ks of 2026-08-06, 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-02. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7, stated in the run file. **Resumed once**: the first cycle was killed by a session limit after Q6 (commit c1b61b45, Q5 and Q6 committed together, recorded as a write-early exception in the self-audit); the 06:17 cycle skipped it as fresh; the 06:46 cycle dispatched one analyst to resume at Q7, which checked and kept the killed session's uncommitted `scripts/q7_range.py`, dropping its $22M a year investment-credit charge (shown beside, moves no case across the floor). **Q1 IN**: four segments, Utilities deciding at 30.0% of five-year segment EBIT (International LPG, Midstream & Marketing and AmeriGas the others), rate base and returns set years ahead under filed plans. **Q2 IN, as the regulated exception**: PA Gas Utility and Mountaineer franchise monopolies at ordinary returns, carried to Q3 as a second best; AmeriGas open on the evidence and not deciding (retail gallons down 24% FY2021 to FY2025 against SPH's 5%, segment EBIT $385M to $166M). **Q3 weighs against**: about $2.2B of net capital added FY2021 to FY2025 for about 2% more segment EBIT; Utilities a decent regulated second best; maintenance guess about 81% of capital spending, stated. **Q4 no STOP, weighs against**: adjusted EPS featured, guidance, yearly one-time charges; balance sheets 2016 to 2026 read, debt $4.1B to $7.1B, goodwill to $3.8B before $851M of AmeriGas impairments. **Q5 integrity IN, ability against**: the 2019 AmeriGas buyout and its written-off goodwill, three chief executives in two years. **Q6 weighs against in both parts**: $459M retained FY2021 to FY2025 for about $0.28 of market value per $2.15 kept, dividends $1,526M above owner cash after all spending of $790M; buybacks at about $33 to $38, above the bottom of the range (written back from Q7); pay on adjusted EPS and a best-of-years TSR from a low base, set at the survey 50th percentile; no all-stock deal, so the narrower STOP not reached. **Q7 OUT, on the floor and above the top**: owner cash FY2021 to FY2025 averages, equity-only after all spending $158M, all-equity $431M after all spending and $735M after maintenance only; net debt $6,573M at 2026-06-30; the growth shown (about 55% a year between halves of a sign-changing series) cut by (f) to sales growth, -0.54% a year, carried as the bottom; growth bought earning about 2% so the maintenance no-growth case is the top. Value range **$12.85 to $33.00 a share** all-equity at the sovereign (equity-only $21.05 to $40.21); expected return at the price 3.5% to 5.0% central, 7.3% on the best beside case; fair price **-$1.95 all-equity, not positive**, $16.20 equity-only. The signed $470M Electric Utility sale beside, at most +$2.19 a share. Net purchases 97% of the serial-acquirer line, so not a serial acquirer and no organic-pair fair figure. Q8 to Q12 not reached. CONVENTIONs of the run: the comparators NFG, WTRG and SPH (the 10-K names no SEC-filing rival); interest added back at the 21% federal statutory rate. Comparators FY2021 to FY2025 (segment net income or EBIT on segment assets): UGI Utilities 3.0% to 4.0% against NFG Utility 2.2% to 3.3% and WTRG gas 2.5% to 2.8% (2021 and 2022 only); AmeriGas 8.6% to 5.7% EBIT on assets against SPH 7.5% to 10.4%. Contamination declared by the analyst: a `Test Runs/` listing showing eight run names dated 2026-10-18 (HOKCY, MDU, NJR, NWN, OGS, SR, SWX, XNGSY), SR fold commit subjects, a memory index line, and on resume a git status naming AYI and ARCB research folders and the overnight-log subject of the UGI skip; none opened or used. Commits 320af629 (Step 0 and Q1), 43005de4 (Q2), d43ebf29 (Q3), 0638f3aa (Q4), c1b61b45 (Q5 and Q6), 857933bb (Q7, Q6's buyback line written back), 617594df (close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `scripts/check_cites.py` 81 ids, 0 problems; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` no E-ids, no missing id, 41 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB (filings in the ignored `cache/`). check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): Q7 (c) silent on divestitures inside or after the window (the averages carry the cash of seven parts sold while net debt holds their proceeds, flattering the range); Whose tax where low cash tax comes from accelerated depreciation rather than expiring credits; the rate at which interest is added back on the all-equity basis. Not armed: the all-equity fair is not positive and the run reports no organic-pair figure (not a serial acquirer); the equity-only $16.20 alert left to the operator. Could not get: the Electric Utility's own owner cash; the owner cash of the parts sold since FY2024; a filed maintenance and growth split; an organic growth figure.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on the floor and above the top of the range (UGI Corporation, NYSE UGI, regulated gas and electric utilities in Pennsylvania and West Virginia, Midstream & Marketing, UGI International LPG and AmeriGas propane; Q1 IN, Utilities deciding at 30.0% of five-year segment EBIT; Q2 IN as the regulated exception, AmeriGas open on the evidence and not deciding; Q3 against: about $2.2B of net capital added for about 2% more segment EBIT; Q4 no STOP, against: adjusted EPS featured, guidance, yearly one-time charges; Q5 integrity IN, ability against: the AmeriGas buyout and $851M of goodwill written off, three CEOs in two years; Q6 against in both parts: dividends above owner cash after all spending, buybacks above the bottom of the range, pay on adjusted EPS and a best-of-years TSR. Owner cash $735M a year after maintenance all-equity, $431M after all spending, $158M equity-only; expected return 3.5% to 5.0% at $38.43 on the central cases; value range $12.85 to $33.00 a share all-equity at the 5.43% Treasury rate; fair price -$1.95 all-equity, not positive, $16.20 equity-only; not armed. Resumed once after a session limit killed the first cycle at Q6. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: divestitures under (c), Whose tax when low cash tax comes from accelerated depreciation, the interest add-back rate.)
